ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is an isotherm distribution map for a certain month; the isotherms are labeled 24, 20, and 16, and the numerical interval is 4°C. Point P is located toward the right of the figure, south of the 20°C isotherm, inside a closed small circle near the 16°C isotherm. Then reason: At P, a closed anomaly appears due to the influence of topography. According to the interpretation rule for closed isolines, the value inside a closed isoline may be “greater than the larger value” or “less than the smaller value”. The question asks for the lower temperature value, so the low-value situation should be taken: the temperature at P should be lower than 16°C; because the isotherm interval is 4°C, the next possible isotherm is 12°C, so P should also be higher than 12°C. A lower temperature value conforming to this range may be 14°C.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中等温线标有24、20、16，间距为4°C，P位于20°C线以南、16°C线附近的闭合小圈内。再推理：P处因地形产生闭合异常，按“闭合等值线内部可大于大值或小于小值”的判读规则，若取较低气温，则应低于16°C但高于下一条可能的12°C等温线。因此可能的较低值为14°C。

再推理：P处因受地形影响出现闭合异常。按闭合等值线判读规则，闭合等值线内部的数值可能“大于较大值”或“小于较小值”。题目问较低气温值，因此应取低值情况：P处气温应低于16°C；由于等温距为4°C，下一条可能等温线为12°C，所以P处又应高于12°C。符合这一范围的较低气温值可为14°C。
